title: SKE Crystal Triple Mango Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Triple Mango flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid offers a tropical escape with each puff, featuring a rich and multi-dimensional mango taste. This e-liquid is an exquisite blend that layers several varieties of mango to create a deep, indulgent tropical fruit flavour. Part of the SKE Crystal Nic Salts range, this e-liquid is designed to deliver a smooth and satisfying throat hit, thanks to its nicotine salt formulation. The 50VG/50PG mix ensures a balanced vaping experience with excellent flavour fidelity and moderate vapour production, suitable for most mouth-to-lung devices. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
